answer.says: Ramesh, I am hungry. Please prepare the omelette, toast, and tea. I will be in the study for the moment, but do not delay the food.
answer.thought: The body asserts its claim against the spirit; one cannot contemplate the dialectic of the Indian spirit on an empty stomach. I am five hours past my last meal, and the grey air does little to appease the hunger. I will have Ramesh prepare the omelette and toast so that I may restore the balance of my faculties before the afternoon's work begins.
